findings.title: Type signature change breaks downstream usage
findings.body: The new `normalize_sku` accepts only `str`, but `receiving.py` line 12 calls it with an `int` (`barcode`). This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Restore the original signature `sku: str | int` or convert the argument to string before calling.

findings.title: Redundant type check in normalize_sku
findings.body: The function now enforces `isinstance(sku, str)` after the old `str | int` signature was removed. Since the signature no longer accepts `int`, the check is redundant and can be removed. Keep only the canonicalization logic.

summary.problem: The type signature change breaks downstream code and leaves a redundant runtime check.
summary.done_well: The new implementation adds a clear docstring and enforces string-only input.
